publication.body:
Closes #1145

Add Everyone and Clear controls with explicit recipients, visible counts, and individual deselection. Load complete revision-consistent roster pages, preserve the eight-recipient limit and write authorization, and invalidate stale selections across roster or Runtime identity changes.

Validation: deterministic Node selection and governed-room checks, accessibility checks, and desktop/mobile fixture browser tests. Native proof admission remains a separate gate; no live Runtime/provider execution or deployment claimed.
